summary_md: **Manoj | The AI Dude ([@Manojkumar2257](https://x.com/Manojkumar2257/status/2116509220292190511))** recommends three MIT agent skills for video side work: **ai-video-editing-skills** (41 local talking-head edits), **long-video-to-shorts** (approved clip lists to captioned 9:16 clips) and **spotlight** (site, clips or CSV to a reviewed promo video) ([AskEditor/ai-video-editing-skills](https://github.com/AskEditor/ai-video-editing-skills), [mihm88/long-video-to-shorts](https://github.com/mihm88/long-video-to-shorts), [AmirSbss/spotlight](https://github.com/AmirSbss/spotlight)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - AskEditor/ai-video-editing-skills: 41 free AI video editing skills for Claude Code and Codex: auto captions, cut pauses and retakes, B-roll, words behind you, colour grade, music. Edit Reels, Shorts and TikTok by asking. Runs on your own computer, nothing uploaded.

GitHub - mihm88/long-video-to-shorts: Agent skill: turn long videos (talks, webinars, podcasts) into short vertical clips with synced word-by-word captions, including correct Arabic/RTL rendering. For Claude Code, Codex and similar agents. · GitHub

GitHub - AmirSbss/spotlight: Open-source Agent Skill that turns a website, phone clips or a CSV into a finished short video: launch videos, promo reels and narrated explainers, made by Claude Code, Codex CLI or Hermes Agent. With music, captions in any language (Arabic and Persian too) and built-in quality checks. · GitHub
